title.zh: 将高山省伊富高次省拉穆特市镇区的伊富高示范农业机会学校的名称变更为Payon Bugan示范农业机会学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Ifugao Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture in the Municipal District of Lamut, Subprovince of Ifugao, Mountain Province, to Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Ifugao Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture in the Municipal District of Lamut, Subprovince of Ifugao, Mountain Province, to Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Nông nghiệp Ifugao Pilot Opportunity tại Quận Lamut, Tiểu tỉnh Ifugao, Tiểu tỉnh Mountain Province thành Trường Nông nghiệp Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนเกษตรศาสตร์ Ifugao Pilot Opportunity ในเขต Lamut กิ่งจังหวัด Ifugao กิ่งจังหวัด Mountain Province เป็นโรงเรียนเกษตรศาสตร์ Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Pertanian Ifugao Pilot Opportunity di Distrik Lamut, Subprovinsi Ifugao, Subprovinsi Mountain Province menjadi Sekolah Pertanian Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Pertanian Ifugao Pilot Opportunity di Daerah Lamut, Subwilayah Ifugao, Subwilayah Mountain Province kepada Sekolah Pertanian Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3724_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Ifugao Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture in the Municipal District of Lamut, Subprovince of Ifugao, Mountain Province, is hereby changed to Payon Bugan Pilot Opportunity School of Agriculture.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1963.
